calendar.note: Quarterly VAT returns and payment are due by the last day of the month after each quarter. The income-tax return is due on 1 May; provisional assessments are paid in monthly instalments and the final one on its notice, so the vault keeps the reserve until the end of the following year.

workdays.note: Taxes paid on a return (VAT, income tax) do not get the weekend extension: the date stays. Kyros shows the last working day before it, so the transfer arrives in time.
